answer: The juniper is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the onyx. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, slashed on a failed audit, each submission carries a fresh nonce. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Reaching the vault of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
